task.description:
Step 3 — implement the fix for ISS-0125 per the validated design at src/design/iss-0125-fk-cascade.md.

Make these concrete edits:

A. Create `migrations/GBL-106_instance_definition_snapshots_cascade.sql` with:
   - File header comment including `-- reapply_on_drift: true`.
   - GBL-prefix rationale comment (operates on public only; blanket-skipped for non-public schemas).
   - `BEGIN;` `ALTER TABLE ONLY public.instance_definition_snapshots DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS instance_definition_snapshots_definition_id_fkey;` `ALTER TABLE ONLY public.instance_definition_snapshots ADD CONSTRAINT instance_definition_snapshots_definition_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (definition_id) REFERENCES public.process_definitions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;` `COMMIT;`
   - Idempotent: re-runs must be no-ops. After the ADD CONSTRAINT, add a guard that checks whether the new constraint already has ON DELETE CASCADE; if not, drop and re-add. OR rely on IF EXISTS in the DROP and assume the ADD will fail if the constraint already exists with the right name — but the simpler/safer pattern is: do the DROP IF EXISTS + ADD in a single transaction; if a previous run already added the constraint with the same name, this will fail with 'constraint already exists', which we accept as the idempotency contract (it is recorded in schema_migrations so will be skipped on subsequent runs).

B. Update `tests/integration/helpers.zig` per design §5 — apply the cleanup-ordering hardening (or doc-comment only if the design concluded no code change is needed). If code change is needed, ensure `resetTestData()` deletes child rows before parent and propagates SQL errors instead of swallowing them.

C. Update each of the four affected test files: `tests/integration/iss202_merge_atomicity_test.zig`, `tests/integration/iss203_idempotency_keys_test.zig`, `tests/integration/iss601_state_snapshots_test.zig`, `tests/integration/event_store_test.zig`. For each, apply the same cleanup-hardening pattern documented in design §5.

Validation (all three must exit 0):
  zig build
  zig build test
  zig build migrate

Error-set check (must produce NO output):
  zig build 2>&1 | grep -i "error set"

Self-review:
- [ ] No SQL string interpolation (prepared statements only).
- [ ] All allocations take an allocator parameter.
- [ ] No I/O added to src/engine/transition.zig (this task does not touch that file).
- [ ] Error types are in the module's error sets.
- [ ] `zig build` exits 0 with no 'error set' output.
- [ ] No mocks, stubs, in-memory fakes, or stub return values in any test file (DIRECTIVE T-1).
- [ ] No `error.SkipZigTest` on any test block that covers a MUST requirement.
- [ ] All integration tests connect to real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL.
- [ ] Migration is idempotent (re-running zig build migrate against an already-migrated DB does not error).

Commit implementation to the feature branch (mandatory):
  git branch --show-current   # must be feature/WF03-gh391-20260801
  git add -A
  git commit -m "feat(WF03-gh391): implement ON DELETE CASCADE fix for ISS-0125"
  git push origin feature/WF03-gh391-20260801

When done, update `handoffs/WF03-gh391-20260801/step-03-backend-dev.json`:
- status: "COMPLETED"
- result.status: "PASS"
- result.summary: short description of changes
- result.artifacts_out: ["migrations/GBL-106_instance_definition_snapshots_cascade.sql", "tests/integration/helpers.zig", list of test files touched]
- result.issues: []
- result.next_action: "Route to TEST-DESIGNER (Step 4)"
- completed_at: exact output of `(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")`

Also update `handoffs/registry.json`: mark entry `WF03-gh391-step03` as COMPLETED with the same completed_at.

Return PASS/FAIL summary.
